title: Frequency question
content: What's up Mallworld people. I haven't had a Mall world dream in awhile. It seems like since ive been active on this sub and other similar forums, commenting about Mall World my dream remembrance has just stopped. I havent been to Mall World in a long time. Is the first rule of Mall World you dont talk about Mall World? The more I speak about dreams and experiences the less they happen. Is this happening to anyone else?
